newsitem.title: USA: Loehmann's moves to address soft sales.
newsitem.headline: Loehmann's moves to address soft sales.

text.p: Loehmann's Inc said Tuesday that fourth quarter sales were below its expectations but it ended the year slightly ahead of plan.
Loehmann's said it believes it has identified the reasons for the softness in its sales during November and December and has "taken the necessary steps going forward."
Loehman's fourth quarter sales rose to $108.6 million from $99.8 million in the year-ago period.

Last month Loehmann's said sales in its three new stores opened in October and November were stronger than anticipated, which lead to an inventory shortage when Loehmann's was experiencing strong store traffic.
And the company said sales were impacted by earlier promotional selling in department stores during December due to the shorter holiday selling period.
